facts.fact: Tchadinfos reports provisional acceptance of PMICE Phase I with inauguration of the Iriba-Doba fibre line at Sarh, a live IP-telephony test linking provincial governorates, and Safitel reporting 15 sites at 100 Gbit/s completed, within a new 1,200 km national backbone; capital connection and traffic in service not stated.
